::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Novr 24 [1896 or earlier]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Mrs Philip Drazin[^1]
:::

My dear [Cordelia](people/person_1593.qmd)
I shall be very glad to see you and [Alethea](people/person_1581.qmd) on Wednesday - tomorrow afternoon if you can come out.  I am sorry I can say no more, but Thursday is [Mother’s Meeting](organizations/other_31.qmd) day. Friday School, Saturday a Sunday School meeting at the Vicarage.

And [Miss Walter](people/person_1462.qmd) is so ill that I dare not make arrangements for more than that short afternoon time

your affectionate cousin
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Cordelia Elizabeth Yonge (1874-1958) and Alethea Yonge (1876-1959) were the younger daughters of CMY’s cousin the Rev. Duke Yonge of Puslinch.  The names were common in the family, but these seem to be the most likely candidates.
